original_resource.题干: 若 $\cos(\alpha-\beta)=\frac{1}{3}$，则 $(\sin \alpha+\sin \beta)^2+(\cos \alpha+\cos \beta)^2 = (\quad)$   A. $\dfrac{8}{3}$　　B. $-\dfrac{8}{3}$　　C. $\dfrac{22}{3}$　　D. $-\dfrac{22}{3}$
original_resource.解析: 答案: A   解析: 原式＝$2 + 2(\sin \alpha \sin \beta + \cos \alpha \cos \beta) = 2 + 2\cos(\alpha - \beta) = 2 + 2 \times \dfrac{1}{3} = \dfrac{8}{3}$．
